## Planning List for Committee Meetings

The following tasks need to be done for each full committee meeting.

### One Month before

-   [ ] Create a [poll](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1bNp3jZc3KZQqrz6UcQTSEdUEDl0btZFdBa03ArnQRkU/edit) to find a meeting time and agenda topics.

    -   Send the email to [all\@nceas.ucsb.edu](mailto:all@nceas.ucsb.edu){.email}

    -   Post in the `#diversity` slack channel

### Two Weeks Before

-   [ ] Contact Ginger Gilquist to add the meeting time to the admin calendar

    - adding the meeting to the events calendar will reserve the room

-   [ ] Check the zoom permalink and have Thomas create a zoom link if necessary to add to the calendar invite

-   [ ] Create a flyer with the meeting time, place, date, zoom link, and description.

-   [ ] Post the flyer in the lounge

-   [ ] Create the meeting agenda (with flyer)

-   [ ] Email the flyer and link to the agenda with the zoom link to [all\@nceas.ucsb.edu](mailto:all@nceas.ucsb.edu){.email}

### Week Before

-   [ ] Email reminder about the DEIJ committee meeting

-   [ ] Finalize plan for meeting

-   [ ] Announce meeting at coffee klatch

### Day Before / Day Of

-   [ ] slack reminders with zoom link for the meeting

## Follow-Up

-   [ ] slack message with meeting notes

-   [ ] create a summary for the exec team if no one from the exec team attends

-   [ ] update any action items or priorities as needed
